WHY_REJECTED.TAKER_CROSS: not evaluated in this build: the first live test is passive-maker only

EV_RECEIPT.WHY_SELECTED: an EV-critical term is NOT_IDENTIFIED, so no valid comparison exists; the unknown is not replaced by zero

TRANSITIONS.WHY: EV-critical terms NOT_IDENTIFIED: FAIR_VALUE, EXPECTED_FEES, P_FILL_VALUE, EV_IF_FILL, EV_IF_NO_FILL

GATES.BOUNDS: age of the book we decided on
all markets on one contest, together
how long a position may sit
how far EV must clear its own error bar
below this, not worth the risk

RISK_RECEIPT.LIMITS_ARE_NOT_SELF_ASSIGNED: the system does not choose the numbers that restrain the system
RISK_RECEIPT.WHY_LIVE_SUBMISSION_STILL_BLOCKED: MICRO_LIVE_MODE = DRY_RUN_NO_SUBMIT; passing the risk gates is necessary and never sufficient
RISK_RECEIPT.WHY_NOT_SET_BLOCKS: a limit with no authorized value is not an unlimited limit; it is a control nobody has agreed to yet, and an unagreed control cannot permit

TELEMETRY_SLOT.MISSING_IS_NOT_ZERO: a telemetry field we failed to capture is missing, not zero; a zero here would be a measurement we never made
TELEMETRY_SLOT.WHY_MARKOUTS: a maker fill that happens just before the price moves against us did not earn the spread; it was selected against, and only the markout shows it

RESULTS.WHY_PASSIVE_ONLY: the first live test is a maker experiment; a taker cross answers a different question and pays the spread to ask it
RESULTS.WHY_VERDICT: NO_TRADE: no valid EV comparison exists

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_PROVE: that any such order would fill, or make money
WHAT_THIS_PROVES: the machinery runs end to end and refuses correctly
